name: kagome
description: Self-contained Japanese Morphological Analyzer written in pure Go

paragraphs: Kagome is an open source Japanese morphological analyzer written in pure Go. It can tokenize Japanese text into words and analyze parts of speech, with dictionaries embedded in the binary for easy deployment.

Key features (Improvements from v1): Self-contained binaries with embedded dictionaries (MeCab-IPADIC, UniDic) Multiple segmentation modes for different use cases RESTful API server mode for production use WebAssembly support for browser environments C library API for FFI integration (Python, PHP, and other languages)
